Hi Olive —

Thanks for applying to the Senior SRE role at Redwood. I'd love to do a short 20‑minute phone screen to learn about your experience and answer a few quick questions about the role.

Are you available for any of these windows next week (I've listed in PST and an approximate SGT conversion):
• Tue 3/7 — 10:00–10:20 PT (Wed 3/8 01:00–01:20 SGT)
• Tue 3/7 — 14:00–14:20 PT (Wed 3/8 05:00–05:20 SGT)
• Wed 3/8 — 07:30–07:50 PT (Wed 3/8 22:30–22:50 SGT)

Also, if you could attach an updated resume (PDF) that would be helpful — I have the copy from your application but want to make sure we look at the latest version.

Cheers,
